d.d: The white of the eye; the tough outer coat of the eye that covers the eyeball except for the cornea.
A chronic systemic autoimmune disease characterized by hardening the skin or other organs through excessive deposits of collagen.
The abnormal hardening of body tissues, such as an artery; the appearance of hardenings, indurations, lesions, nodules.
Inability to create change or excessive resistance to change.
Of or relating to the sclera of the eye.
Having or relating to sclerosis; hardened.
Hard and insular; resistant to change.
